channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Rock
channel.description: What happened or was announced on the ground at Mission Rock, San Francisco: dated milestones and the changes they brought to the record. Every item names its source.

item.title: Status · Verde: Chipotle's own page for its Mission Rock restaurant (365 Toni Stone Xing, Unit C)…
item.description: Chipotle's own page for its Mission Rock restaurant (365 Toni Stone Xing, Unit C) gives an open date of September 23, 2026, with daily hours and online ordering, in data timestamped September 24, 2026. The restaurant was previously shown as announced, on a December 2025 post that expected a 2026 opening. The date is the company's own statement; no news report of the opening was found. Source: https://locations.chipotle.com/ca/san-francisco/365-toni-stone-xing.

item.title: Milestone · Piers 38 & 40: The Registry SF publishes a teaser (the rest is behind a… (Aug 12, 2026)

item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Block C: Port Commission approves Resolution 26-34… (Jun 9, 2026)
item.description: Port Commission approves Resolution 26-34, authorizing up to $10 million in Port Capital as pre-development funding for Phase 2 (for eligible Phase 2 pre-development costs, including 'design and engineering for Phase 2 infrastructure; Developer, Port, and City staff costs; consultant expenses'; the memo separately says the Developer will advance pre-development and design work for the vertical buildings in parallel), intended to avoid a 12-18 month delay to construction readiness. Staff's schedule lists a 'Potential Construction Start' of Summer/Fall 2027 for horizontal infrastructure and vertical building construction, and the memo says Phase 2 could begin construction 'as early as 2027' once anchor tenants are secured; its Table 1 gives illustrative repayment scenarios for a 2027, 2028 or 2029 vertical start – not a committed date for this or any other Phase 2 block. (Jun 9, 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-06-05; Port of San Francisco, 2026-06-09.
item.source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-06-05; Port of San Francisco, 2026-06-09

item.title: Milestone · Piers 38 & 40: Port Commission adopts a Settlement Agreement… (Apr 28, 2026)
item.description: Port Commission adopts a Settlement Agreement (Resolution 26-21: Pacific Waterfront Partners to pay $720,000 over 3 years, with the remaining debt forgiven on compliance) and an Amended and Restated ENA (Resolution 26-22: a 12-month "Evaluation Period" for the developer to pursue value engineering, project phasing and a new financial partner, with a new Schedule of Performance due before the period ends; Resolution 26-22 says within twelve months after execution of the Amended ENA, and the execution date is not in the sources read, so the end falls roughly in April 2027 if it was signed soon after adoption). item.title: Milestone · The Canyon: Board of Supervisors adopts Resolution No. 193-25 (File No.… (Apr 29, 2025)
item.description: Board of Supervisors adopts Resolution No. 193-25 (File No. 250264), approving the Mission Rock Housing Plan amendment that lowers the minimum percentage of below-market-rate units per Phase from 30% to 20%, by a vote of 11 to 0 (the Land Use and Transportation Committee had recommended it on April 28). This is the Housing Plan amendment on which the Port's March 2025 reduction of Parcel A's units was conditioned; the Parcel A lease amendment is a separate item. (Apr 29, 2025). Source: San Francisco Board of Supervisors, 2025-04-29; Port of San Francisco, 2025-03-07.
item.source: San Francisco Board of Supervisors, 2025-04-29; Port of San Francisco, 2025-03-07
